appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Shrinking Population of City A from 2010 to 2015'.
The y-axis has major gridlines and labels at 0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 3000, and 3500.
The x-axis has major gridlines and labels for the years 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, and 2015.
A single blue line traces the population trend from 2010 to 2015.
The data point for 2010 is at the y-axis value of 2000.
The data point for 2015 is at the y-axis value of 3000.

public_definitions: Review the City A population dashboard for 2010-2015, then choose the follow-up route for the population planning workflow.
Use the City A population dashboard as the evidence source for the population trend routing decision.
The three available options are: 'Route to population growth planning', 'Route to population decline response', and 'Keep on routine population monitoring'.
